## Setup

If these packages are not already installed, run this once:

```{r install, eval = FALSE}
install.packages(c("readxl", "dplyr", "knitr", "rmarkdown"))
```

```{r libraries}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
```

## Load the claims data

The dataset is 100,000 members with 12 months of continuous eligibility,
so 1,200,000 member months. Claims experience is 2025; we are pricing for
2027.

```{r load}
df <- readRDS("data/claims_2025.rds")

# The sheet carries a few blank rows past the last member record.
# Drop them so they do not form a spurious age group.
df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(AGE))

nrow(df)
```

```{r age-groups}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(Age_Group = case_when(
    AGE <= 17               ~ "0-17",
    AGE >= 18 & AGE <= 44   ~ "18-44",
    AGE >= 45               ~ "45+"
  ))

table(df$Age_Group)
```

## Plan designs

GIA: $200 deductible, then 10% coinsurance.

```{r gia}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    GIA_Paid_Est = pmax(`Medical Allowed` - 200, 0) * 0.9
  )
```

XAX: $200 general deductible, $1,000 inpatient facility deductible,
10% coinsurance on all other services.

```{r xax}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    XAX_IPF_Paid      = pmax(`IP Facility Allowed` - 1000, 0),
    XAX_Other_Allowed = `Medical Allowed` - `IP Facility Allowed`,
    XAX_Other_Paid    = pmax(XAX_Other_Allowed - 200, 0) * 0.9,
    XAX_Paid_Est      = XAX_IPF_Paid + XAX_Other_Paid
  )
```

## Claims PMPM by age group

Rx is excluded from the claims cost because the proposed CYA plan does not
reimburse prescription drugs. Rx claim counts are still used in the
administrative load below.

```{r pmpm}
pmpm_by_age <- df %>%
  group_by(Age_Group) %>%
  summarise(
    members        = n(),
    total_allowed  = sum(`Medical Allowed`, na.rm = TRUE),
    GIA_total_paid = sum(GIA_Paid_Est,      na.rm = TRUE),
    XAX_total_paid = sum(XAX_Paid_Est,      na.rm = TRUE),
    PMPM_Allowed   = total_allowed  / (members * 12),
    GIA_PMPM       = GIA_total_paid / (members * 12),
    XAX_PMPM       = XAX_total_paid / (members * 12)
  )

pmpm_by_age
```

## Trend to the pricing year

Experience is 2025 and we are pricing for 2027, so two years of trend at
6% per year.

```{r trend}
trend_factor <- 1.06^2

pmpm_by_age <- pmpm_by_age %>%
  mutate(
    PMPM_Allowed_2027 = PMPM_Allowed * trend_factor,
    GIA_PMPM_2027     = GIA_PMPM     * trend_factor,
    XAX_PMPM_2027     = XAX_PMPM     * trend_factor
  )
```

## Administrative load

$50 per policy per year, $10 per medical claim, $5 per Rx claim,
expressed as a percentage of allowed claims.

```{r admin}
admin_fixed <- 50

admin_summary <- df %>%
  summarise(
    med_claims = sum(`Medical Claim Count`, na.rm = TRUE),
    rx_claims  = sum(`Rx Claim Count`,      na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    admin_total = admin_fixed * nrow(df) + 10 * med_claims + 5 * rx_claims
  )

total_admin   <- admin_summary$admin_total
total_allowed <- sum(df$`Medical Allowed`, na.rm = TRUE)
admin_load    <- total_admin / total_allowed

cat("Total administrative expense:",
    format(round(total_admin), big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("Total allowed charges:      ",
    format(round(total_allowed), big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("Administrative load:        ",
    round(admin_load * 100, 2), "% of allowed claims\n")
```

## Projected 2027 rates

Two loads are applied: the administrative load calculated above, and a
10% allowance for agent compensation.

```{r rates}
agent_load <- 0.10

pmpm_by_age <- pmpm_by_age %>%
  mutate(
    GIA_Gross_Premium = GIA_PMPM_2027 / (1 - admin_load - agent_load),
    XAX_Gross_Premium = XAX_PMPM_2027 / (1 - admin_load - agent_load)
  )
```

## Results

```{r results-claims}
knitr::kable(
  pmpm_by_age %>%
    select(Age_Group, members, PMPM_Allowed, GIA_PMPM, XAX_PMPM),
  digits  = 2,
  caption = "2025 claims cost PMPM by age group"
)
```

```{r results-rates}
knitr::kable(
  pmpm_by_age %>%
    select(Age_Group,
           GIA_PMPM_2027, XAX_PMPM_2027,
           GIA_Gross_Premium, XAX_Gross_Premium),
  digits  = 2,
  caption = "2027 trended claims and gross premiums by age group"
)
```
